failureInsight.title: {{count}} message(s) couldn't be delivered
failureInsight.intro: When a broadcast shows failures, it's usually one of these:
failureInsight.reasonDisconnected: WhatsApp dropped offline part-way through the send
failureInsight.reasonNotOnWhatsapp: Some numbers don't have a WhatsApp account
failureInsight.reasonWarmup: Your number hit its daily warm-up limit — new numbers are throttled to avoid bans
failureInsight.reasonInvalid: A number couldn't be read as a phone number. Check it has all its digits, e.g. 05XXXXXXXX or +9665XXXXXXXX
failureInsight.tip: Keep WhatsApp connected while broadcasts run, and make sure numbers are valid and on WhatsApp.

smart.subtitle: Send large campaigns in safe batches to protect your number from WhatsApp limits.

risk.confirmTitle: This campaign could get your number restricted
risk.confirmBody: The safety check rated this campaign critical risk. Sending it as it stands may lead WhatsApp to restrict this Business account.

health.title: WhatsApp number health
health.budgetLine: {{used}} of {{limit}} campaign messages sent today · {{remaining}} left
health.allClear: No warning signs in the last {{days}} days. Keep replies flowing and this stays green.

safety.subtitle: How this campaign will reach people — and what it costs your WhatsApp number.
safety.pacingBlurb_CAREFUL: Long, irregular gaps. Best for new numbers or cold audiences.
safety.pacingBlurb_BALANCED: Natural, hand-paced delivery. The safe default.
safety.pacingBlurb_STEADY: Faster. Only for mature numbers with engaged audiences.
safety.pacingCapped: Not available until your number has a longer track record.
safety.quietHoursHint: Nobody is messaged during their local night. Recipients in other countries are handled on their own clock.
safety.pilot: Test on a small group first
safety.pilotHint: Send to your most engaged contacts, then pause so you can see the replies before the rest goes out.
safety.pacingIntro: We pick the safest speed your number can handle. You can always go slower.
safety.reassessing: Checking against your account right now…
safety.noReport: No safety check for this campaign yet.
safety.noTemplate: No template selected. WhatsApp requires one for anyone who has not messaged you in the last 24 hours.

template_required.label: Choose an approved template
template_required.detail: WhatsApp only delivers a template it has approved to people who haven’t messaged you in the last 24 hours.

template_missing.label: The selected template no longer exists
template_missing.detail: Choose another template for this campaign.

template_not_approved.label: “{{name}}” is not approved for sending
template_not_approved.detail_PENDING: WhatsApp is still reviewing this template. It usually takes minutes, sometimes up to 24 hours.
template_not_approved.detail_PAUSED: WhatsApp paused this template because recipients reacted badly to it. Use a different one.
template_not_approved.detail_DISABLED: WhatsApp turned this template off permanently. Use a different one.
template_not_approved.detail: This template can’t be sent right now. Choose an approved one.

template_blanks_unset.detail: For each blank, choose a contact detail such as the name, or type the same text for everyone.

template_blank_missing.detail: They will see “{{shown}}” in blank {{slot}} instead. You can change this backup text next to the blank.

recent_repeat.label_one: 1 of these people got this template in the last 24 hours
recent_repeat.label_other: {{count}} of these people got this template in the last 24 hours
recent_repeat.detail: WhatsApp usually holds back a repeat marketing message within a day, and people who get the same offer twice are the ones who block. Leave them out to keep your number in good standing.

channel_not_connected.label: No WhatsApp number is connected
channel_not_connected.detail: A manager needs to connect the business number in Settings → WhatsApp.

channel_unavailable.label: This WhatsApp number can’t send right now

empty_audience.label: No one would receive this campaign
empty_audience.detail: Every selected contact was left out or has a phone number WhatsApp can’t use.

over_messaging_tier.label: Your number can start {{capacity}} new conversations a day
over_messaging_tier.detail: This campaign goes to {{count}} people. WhatsApp will hold back the rest until your limit resets, and sending continues by itself the next day.

quality_rating_low.label: WhatsApp rates your number’s quality as {{rating}}
quality_rating_low.detail: People have been blocking or reporting your messages. Sending more marketing now could make Meta lower your daily limit.

country_assumed.label_one: 1 number was saved without a country code
country_assumed.label_other: {{count}} numbers were saved without a country code
country_assumed.detail: They were read as: {{breakdown}}. If any belong to another country, add its code to the contact (for example +971 for UAE, +20 for Egypt).

monitor.autoPaused: Sending stopped — your attention is needed
monitor.resumeWarning: Fix the cause first (edit the campaign if it’s the template), then resume. Nobody gets the message twice.
monitor.pilotHint: Check for replies and blocks, then release the rest of the campaign.
monitor.waiting: Pausing between batches — delivery resumes at {{time}}.
monitor.forecastBeaten: This was rated low risk before sending, but WhatsApp has refused messages since. Trust the measurement.

skipReason.COLD_EXCLUDED: Has never messaged you — excluded by choice

errorCode.RATE_LIMITED: Sending too quickly — WhatsApp throttled this
